items.title: Nvidia stock plunges 14%, wraps up longest weekly losing streak since 2008 financial crisis

items.title: Zscaler stock jumps 18% on report that CrowdStrike in talks to buy security vendor

items.title: Experts warn: Nearly everyone in AI is susceptible to a honey-trap scheme right now
items.title_zh: 专家警告：目前，几乎所有从事人工智能工作的人都容易落入“美人计”陷阱
items.summary: Techies are building technology that can advance all aspects of the world — but can they protect their hearts? That's the vulnerability that honey pots exploit.
items.summary_zh: 技术人员正在打造能够推动世界方方面面进步的技术，但他们能保护自己的内心吗？这就是蜜罐所利用的漏洞。

items.title: YouTube is reportedly preparing to settle social media addiction claims for $3 billion
items.title_zh: 据报道，YouTube正准备以30亿美元的和解金解决社交媒体成瘾索赔
